summary: record the Web-run backtest, strategy registry, result-page and permission-UI goals and add the tasks that deliver them
owner_direction: Owner direction (2026-09-20), four parts. (1) Strategy registry and Web-triggered backtest: the Web console must list the available strategies with each one's parameter schema, version and code provenance, and the owner must be able to choose a strategy, its parameters and a time range there and trigger a backtest run, with run status, progress, failure and cancellation visible. Today no product-level entry point joins stored data, replay, features, the engine and a manifest into a run; strategy identity is a closed five-kind vocabulary that does not even name the T065 adaptive strategy. (2) Backtest result page: the console spec must carry the agreed visualization for price with the LP tick range band and entry/increase/decrease/collect/rebalance/exit markers, a layered hover (L0 always-on, L1 hover of at most five rows, L2 pinned detail drawer, L3 full table view), and the companion charts for equity and drawdown, PnL attribution including an explicit unexplained residual, inventory, tick liquidity distribution, and data coverage with gaps drawn as gaps. (3) Pre-P07 authorization entry: the contracts must state who completes pool selection, the HOLD/LP approvals and the preliminary-paper authorization, and through which entry point, before P07 runs paper, because the Web write path T085 currently comes after P07 while PROJECT_GOALS.md names the Web as the only normal permission entry. (4) Permission adjustment stays on the Web as the only write entry for increasing permission or exposure: draft, impact preview, reauthentication, explicit confirmation, immutable version and audit event, and a reduction must never be blocked by an increase-risk flow. CLI: the read-only query interface is retained, and the CLI additionally gains reduce-only write commands - reduce or remove LP, collect, exit, turn HOLD/LP/AUTO_SWAP off, lower an exposure limit - while any increase in permission or exposure remains Web-only.
